name: ProtoSoul lit by the kind after its own
what: UNITE's check reads the chip's kind one up (Sword as Invisible): the Sword lights ShadowSoul, which BN6's MegaMan does not hold, so ProtoSoul never unites where BN5's does at t1

name: ProtoSoul drawn as the next Soul
what: the sprite selector draws GyroSoul's sprite (list 0 0x61) where BN5 draws ProtoSoul's (its list 0's 1): his object's sprite word
